target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Absolute beginners with no social media presence.

prerequisites.required: Basic understanding of social media platforms.
prerequisites.recommended: Existing active accounts on Instagram and YouTube.

system_requirements.hardware: Smartphone with a good camera, PC/Laptop.

overview.positioning: The essential bootcamp to become a versatile, multi-platform content creator and storyteller.
overview.short_description: Learn to ideate, produce, and distribute high-performing content across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok while building a cohesive personal brand.

key_facts.capstone: Produce a cross-platform content campaign for a chosen niche.

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Develop a unified multi-platform content strategy.
Shoot and edit engaging short-form and long-form video content.
Design compelling graphics and carousels using Canva.
Organize content pipelines efficiently using Notion.
Analyze cross-platform metrics to refine content strategy.

why_now.industry_shift: Brands demand creators who can operate across multiple platforms seamlessly.
why_now.ai_impact: Generative AI is streamlining content repurposing.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for versatile creators who understand both video and visual design.
why_now.career_opportunity: Freelance content creation is a rapidly growing sector.

learning_outcomes: PLAN: A cohesive multi-platform content calendar.
REPURPOSE: Long-form content into short-form assets efficiently.
DISTRIBUTE: Content natively on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.
ENGAGE: Build and nurture an active online community.

stages.name: Scheduling
stages.desc: Setting up posts for the week.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Need for agile content creation for clients.
business_use_cases.approach: Deploy versatile creators who can handle end-to-end production.

ai_integration.validation_protocol: Review AI copy for tone and accuracy.

best_practices: Batch create content to save time.
Tailor the format to the specific platform.
Hook the audience in the first 3 seconds.

common_mistakes.mistake: Cross-posting watermarked TikToks to Instagram Reels.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Export clean versions and upload natively.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Brand discovery -> Content proposal -> Batch creation -> Delivery.
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Examples of past successful campaigns and metrics.

what_you_will_build: A unified content calendar in Notion.
A portfolio of edited videos and graphics.
final_deliverables: A 30-day cross-platform content plan fully executed.

assessment.criteria: Creativity, technical execution, and strategic alignment.

certification.title: Certified Content Creator
certification.criteria: Completion of all modules and the 30-day content campaign.
certification.verification: Review of social channels and content portfolio.

faq.question: Do I need a professional camera?
faq.answer: No, a modern smartphone is completely sufficient for this course.

faq.question: Is this focused on just one platform?
faq.answer: No, it covers a multi-platform approach including Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.

faq.question: Can I use this for my business?
faq.answer: Absolutely. The strategies apply to personal brands and businesses alike.
